coverLetter.intro: I am a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience building and shipping production web applications.

pitch.default: I work across both the JavaScript stack (NestJS, Next.js, React, Node.js, MongoDB) and PHP/Laravel, and I currently own the AI Screening and AI Interview modules at Qureos end to end.
pitch.laravel: Most of my career has been in PHP/Laravel, most recently delivering KYC onboarding, portfolio management and regulatory features for a regulated robo-advisory platform at Abyan Capital.
pitch.tall: Most of my career has been in Laravel, including Livewire, Alpine.js, Filament and Inertia.js, most recently on a regulated robo-advisory fintech platform at Abyan Capital.
pitch.laravel-vue: I have built Laravel back ends with JavaScript front ends (Vue.js, Inertia.js, React) for fintech, marketplace and auction products.
pitch.mern: I have built MERN applications for international clients and now own the AI Screening and AI Interview modules at Qureos on NestJS, Next.js and MongoDB.
pitch.pern: I build TypeScript/Node.js services and React front ends on PostgreSQL and MongoDB, currently at Qureos on NestJS and Next.js.
pitch.next-nest: I currently own the AI Screening and AI Interview modules at Qureos, built on NestJS and Next.js, from technical design through release.
pitch.backend-node: At Qureos I build NestJS services, including LLM screening pipelines that process 5,000–10,000 candidates per request with quota-based cost controls.
pitch.frontend-react: I build product front ends in React, Next.js and Redux, and I am comfortable down the stack in Node.js/NestJS and Laravel.
pitch.ai-fullstack: At Qureos I own AI Screening and AI Interview: LLM-powered screening on OpenAI GPT APIs that ranks candidates, running 5,000–10,000 candidates per request with predictable per-candidate cost.

coverLetter.strengths: I own features end to end, from technical design and estimation to tests, code review and release, and I have mentored engineers in agile teams.
coverLetter.remote: have worked remotely with international clients and distributed teams, and am comfortable overlapping with European and Middle East working hours
